text:
mike: Heads-up — Solaris is asking for a weekend-burst option on their Dedicated commitment. They want to keep 80k GPU-hrs/month reserved but allow up to +40% capacity Sat–Sun with automatic scaling. Need a quick feasibility check.

sophia: Do we have APAC headroom for weekend peaks? APAC A100s were near capacity last month; telemetry showed ~1.2k idle GPU-hrs.

cheng: Quick back-of-envelope: 80k reserved -> +40% peak = 32k additional peak capacity, but if burst is only for weekend windows it’s much less in raw hours. If they mean full 24h on ~8 weekend days that's ~6.4k extra GPU-hrs/mo (not 32k). We need exact traffic shape.

laura: Solaris says spikes are concentrated Sat 20:00–04:00 UTC (they run heavy batch evals then). They want APAC primary; failover to us-west if APAC saturated. Also requires VPC-only connectivity and audit logs.

marta-sales: From renewal convo: customer will accept burst pricing at 1.5x reserved rate, or 1.25x if we guarantee <15% throttling during bursts. They want simple language in the contract.

cheng: Pricing aside, two infra flags: (1) APAC capacity is tight — failover to us-west is feasible but increases egress/latency and could trigger different instance types; (2) need per-cust burst caps and per-minute throttle to avoid noisy-neighbor storms.

infra-bot: capacity-check: apac a100 free_hours next30d = 1200; us-west a100 free_hours next30d = 18400.

sophia: If we route to us-west, p95 latency for APAC-origin jobs could jump; we should document expected SLO impact in the proposal and require customer opt-in for cross-region failover. Also we should add a canary window for the first 2 weekends.

mike: Action items: cheng — run scenario sims for "80k reserved + weekend +40%" across 30d (hourly granularity) and output headroom, likely throttles, and cost delta; sophia — map APAC->US failover egress and latency delta; laura — request Solaris application logs for last 3 months and ask them to flag weekend spike samples; marta-sales — draft pricing language with burst tiers and throttling guardrails. Sync tomorrow 11am PT.

laura: +1, I'll pull logs and ask them to annotate the weekend spike windows.

cheng: Starting sims now; will paste a small table and a spreadsheet link when ready.

mike: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
thread_text_preview: Solaris asks for weekend burst (80k reserved +40%) — feasibility, APAC headroom, cross-region failover, and pricing negotiation. Action items assigned.
